content: The shared CortexDB brain serves gRPC on port 47821 behind the VIP 192.168.123.253; the public entry is a Caddy proxy.
Athanor's Vite dev server runs on port 3076 and proxies /api to the Go backend on 6759.
Grafana on the infra VM listens on 3000; it predates the random-port convention and was left alone.
The haify controller REST API listens on 7310 on every meta node.
noted's server runs as a systemd unit on the apps VM and stores its data in /var/lib/noted/noted.db.
The SuperAI hive queen runs on the orange k3s cluster; workers register over WebSocket on startup.
On 2026-11-08 the harness-rs history was rewritten with git filter-repo to remove a leaked key, and every clone was re-made.
oldtimes keeps its GLB models in git LFS; a clone without LFS gets pointer files and the 3D radio renders blank.
linstor-gui CI runs lint, unit tests and a Playwright smoke suite; the smoke suite needs a controller mock.
TagIt's daemon is a LaunchAgent on the Mac, not a brew service, since 2026-08-22.
Vita reads sleep and step data through HealthKit and never sends it off the phone.
argus pulls foreign news from GDELT every fifteen minutes through the home proxy.
EduMind runs on dell VM 104; its database is PostgreSQL 16 on the same VM.
SmartFactory embeds the CortexDB live view per company and implements Source.Ontology itself.
steward turns code and docs into a knowledge graph with an ontology on top of CortexDB.
The dell VMs reach the internet through the mihomo proxy at 192.168.123.61:43127, configured in /etc/environment.
The Mac runs ollama with embeddinggemma (768 dimensions) for the brain's query embeddings.
The PostgreSQL backend is tested against a pgvector pg17 container on the infra VM with max_connections 400.
Bumping version.go requires syncing seven plugin manifests or the version-consistency gate fails.
The Obsidian plugin keeps its brain token in app.secretStorage under the id cortexdb.
Hermes 0.21 needs about 2.6 GB on disk, so it is installed per node under /opt/hermes.
The Mac's Lima has lg1 to lg3 for LINSTOR tests and sds-a for openclaw; dsh-dev was deleted on 2026-10-14.
The Claude Chrome extension lives in Chrome Profile 14.
The recall golden set v2 has 48 labelled cases and 7 negatives across lexical, paraphrase, CJK and graph categories.
HNSW uses efSearch 64 by default; raising it to 128 recovered recall@10 on the 50k benchmark at 1.4x latency.
The PageRank cache is invalidated whenever a graph write bumps the graph version counter.
On 2026-11-13 the shared brain's graph had about 41,000 nodes and 118,000 edges.
The 2026-11-16 pricing call settled on a fixed-fee pilot for the first manufacturing customer.
The apps VM has an old Go toolchain, so binaries for it are cross-compiled on the Mac.
Public domains go through Caddy on the aliyun box, which forwards over the tailnet to home services.
superleo reads its brain address and token from /home/ops/superleo/superleo.env.
noted's alarms follow the Chinese public holiday and make-up workday calendar when asked.
WeChat articles cap inline images at 10 MB each.
Xiaohongshu covers render best at 1242x1660 with the headline in the upper third.
The CPA model gateway runs on the home network and fronts several model providers behind one endpoint.
The orange cluster is three k3s nodes; orange1 holds the control plane.
The cortexdb HA resource is a 4 GB DRBD volume mounted at /var/lib/cortexdb on the Primary.
linstor-gui tracks every change as a GitLab work item; branches are named after the item.
agentexec's macOS CI runner silently lost PTY output until v0.2.1 fixed the read loop.
CortexDB opens SQLite in WAL mode with a 5 second busy timeout.
agentmem uses the FTS5 trigram tokenizer and falls back to unicode61 when the build lacks it.
Bulk embedding of 6,000 memories took 11 minutes on the Mac's ollama at batch size 16.
openclaw floats on VIP 192.168.123.252 across node-a, node-b and node-e.
node-c was removed as an openclaw failover candidate because the VIP stayed bound to its loopback.
yahoo-finance-mcp-server keeps its venv in ~/.cache/yahoo-finance-mcp/venv with a sentinel named after the requirements hash.
The starshop mockups are in a Figma file shared with the design contractor.
mlx-ipados runs a 4B model on the iPad Pro at about 22 tokens per second.
The qi language interpolates with "${expr}" in double-quoted strings; backtick strings stay literal.
Suishou's skeleton extraction breaks strokes at crossings, so flares are only added at free ends.
SmartAlarm pairing codes are eight digits and valid for five minutes.
CortexDB stays pure Go with modernc.org/sqlite; no CGO dependency is accepted in pkg/.
No LLM SDK is imported under pkg/; LLM features are interfaces and concrete clients live in examples.
Athanor's UI is a separate Vite, React and Tailwind project; the Go server only returns JSON.
The brain moved to its own haify HA resource on 2026-10-14 instead of riding along with openclaw.
SuperAI hive members message each other through agent-go's Steer instead of a shared queue.
Life rules such as pickups and reminders live only in noted, not in openclaw scripts or the brain.
TagIt's daemon was moved to a LaunchAgent so it starts with the user session.
Vita lets the model parse natural-language notes into relative offsets; code resolves the dates.
argus gets a local prepend rule set on the home proxy so foreign news sites skip the default group.
The DataIntelligence Rust port runs beside the Go version until it matches every answer.
opsdoctor was renamed steward on 2026-10-28.
Since 2026-10-16 the brain embeds queries on the Mac's ollama; when the Mac sleeps recall falls back to keywords.
Recall gained an index detail level that returns one line per hit, so callers fetch only what they pick.
An outdated memory is superseded, not deleted: it stays exported and linked forward, and recall stops returning it.
With CORTEXDB_REVIEW_GATE=1 proposed and rejected records are hidden from recall.
Listing tools page with opaque cursors because a single gRPC message tops out near 4 MiB.
The live view's Library became a view of the Graph page in v2.154.5.
Keyword ordering on PostgreSQL is tracked in issue 119 and accepted as a known difference.
The public haify release ships the knowledge base without the LINBIT KB and internal notes.
SmartFactory mounts the live view WithoutPages so its own navigation stays in charge.
X posts introduce CortexDB through everyday scenes instead of release notes.
GUI changes are checked against the real controller on the Lima VMs, not only the mock e2e suite.
harness-rs consulting targets small automotive parts manufacturers first.
The oldtimes radio dial is cream coloured to avoid glare in the daylight scene.
qi compiles to WebAssembly for the playground and to native code for the CLI.
The stdio MCP server handles requests concurrently; probes wait for a save before searching.
Hook recalls pass graph_light to skip the heavy graph walk and stay under the hook timeout.
Auto-recall is opt-in through a sentinel file in the cache directory that both shell hooks and the mod read.
Large refactors get a second pass from Codex before they are merged.
noted distinguishes alarm, reminder and notification by how hard the phone interrupts.
SQLite compares created_at as text: binding a time.Time adds a zone suffix and breaks keyset paging, so the cursor binds the exact stored layout.
PostgreSQL timestamps keep microseconds; flooring a cursor to seconds silently skipped rows.
Claude Code replaces an additionalContext over about ten thousand characters with a short preview, so hooks cut whole lines under 9,000.
pkg/cortexdb takes about 680 seconds under -race on the Mac; a 10 minute timeout panic is not a failure.
Shell exports of CORTEXDB_REMOTE and OLLAMA_HOST made tests call live services; run suites with env -i.
A key scan for sk- also matches task-notification, so the scan must fail the command and be read, not skimmed.
Installing Hermes onto the DRBD volume filled it on 2026-10-12; large runtimes stay node-local.
Stopping haify-ai alone stops the whole haify-meta group; deploy by installing on standbys and evicting.
Go's FileServer sets no Cache-Control, so a cached index.html named a bundle the deploy had removed.
PVE 9 applies node affinity rules immediately and migrates running VMs at once.
The gpt proxy sometimes drops the closing brace of JSON; adapters repair and retry.
TagIt's rage loop came from letting the model signal completion by writing nothing.
Chinese sentence queries returned nothing until the lexical path searched CJK bigrams.
An English question whose answer memory is written in Chinese cannot be found lexically; only embeddings bridge it.
noted and superleo kept the old brain token after the VIP move and failed to sync for hours; grep every client when rotating.
Removing protected Mac app containers works through ssh localhost, whose sshd has full disk access.
pbcopy inside the sandbox never reaches the user's clipboard.
The session scratchpad can be cleared mid-session; long builds and snapshots go under ~/.cache.
On macOS a PTY read that returns EIO after the child exits still holds buffered output; drain before closing.
The supersede step must be strict: two facts that can both be true are not a contradiction.
Golden-set negatives get contaminated when a memory quotes the negative queries verbatim.
Keyword lists for parsing health notes covered only two languages and missed most phrasing.
The iPad throttles after eight minutes of generation; batch prompts to keep it cool.
WeChat's editor drops nested lists pasted from Markdown.
CortexDB v2.154.6 shipped on 2026-11-16 with deterministic fallback-scan memory tests.
Athanor is deployed on the apps VM at athanor.superleo.cn through aliyun and the tailnet.
The haify web console gained a pool view and disk replacement wizard in October.
The SuperAI Apple Watch app was submitted on 2026-10-06.
noted's iOS app shows the day's schedule and rings alarms through critical notifications.
TagIt v0.3 adds folder rules and a menu bar status item.
Vita's TestFlight beta went to five testers on 2026-11-02.
argus's board groups stories by region and shows a 24-hour trend per topic.
EduMind generates weekly class reports as PDFs every Sunday night.
SmartFactory onboarded its second company on 2026-11-10.
steward imported the haify repository: 2,300 files, 9,800 graph nodes.
The first harness-rs pilot starts in December at a brake-pad supplier.
oldtimes' 3D radio tunes between stations with a drag gesture.
starshop v1 has a catalogue, a cart and a WeChat Pay checkout.
The qi playground runs in the browser and shares snippets by URL.
The cortexdb-live mod shows a recall band above the prompt and captures sessions when idle.
CortexDB publishes Python, TypeScript and Rust clients from client-v tags.
linstor-gui 2.x moves resource creation into a step-by-step drawer.
agentbench compared six agent harnesses on 40 coding tasks in August.
mlx-ipados has a chat screen with model switching and token speed display.
SmartAlarm exposes its alarms over MCP after an OAuth pairing.
Yesterday's pricing discussion compared per-seat licensing with a fixed monthly retainer.
Recall@10 on the HNSW benchmark fell from 0.97 to 0.91 after the graph was rebuilt with M 12.
README_CN.md mirrors README.md and is updated in the same change.
Athanor's search API answers in 40 ms at p50 and 180 ms at p95 on the apps VM.
Athanor's production bundle is 310 KB gzipped after code splitting the editor.
The CortexDB docs live in docs/GUIDE.md and are published from llms-full.txt for agents.
argus's scraper respects robots.txt and backs off for an hour after a 429.
The data-cleaning notebook for EduMind drops duplicate students by ID card number.
noted stores user settings as one JSON row per user.
SmartFactory's dashboard counts OEE, scrap rate and downtime per line.
noted's inbox collects captured notes until they are filed into a project.
The warehouse layout has 14 aisles and two loading docks on the east side.
The harness-rs landing page headline was tested in two variants in October.
SuperAI had 42 sign-ups in the first week of November.
Vita's onboarding asks for HealthKit permission on the third screen.
TagIt crashed on files with a colon in the name until v0.2.4.
Athanor's ingest endpoint is rate limited to 20 requests per second per key.
starshop settles payments through WeChat Pay with a T+1 payout.
SuperAI images are pushed to the GitHub container registry under the superai organisation.
The cortexdb-grpc image is built from a distroless base and is 38 MB.
EduMind's compose file defines the web app, a worker and PostgreSQL.
Integration tests create a fresh SQLite file per test under t.TempDir().
journald on the cluster nodes keeps two weeks of logs.
Releases are cut from main after the race suite passes; the tag triggers the binary builds.
Outside contributors' PRs are rebased by the maintainer and keep their original commits.
Each CortexDB PR lands as one commit; follow-ups are amended and force-pushed to the PR branch.
linstor-gui MRs need one approval from a maintainer before merge.
linstor-server's master is protected; work goes through MRs from work-item branches.
SuperAI's webhook receiver is written in Go, not Python.
argus moved from requests to httpx for HTTP/2 support.
Personalized PageRank in recall uses damping 0.85 and 20 iterations.
graph_statistics returns node and edge counts by type in one call.
